**Next signal:** Whether Tehran escalates against Gulf host states or attempts more Mediterranean/Suez disruptions, which would move oil and insurance markets sharply.

海军与印太.zh:
概览：日本远程打击能力跨过质变门槛，美国水下舰队迎来“超级合同”，美航母重返越南则显示南海外交军事化仍同步推进。

- 日本海自“鸟海”号驱逐舰在太平洋首次发射战斧，成为正式加入战斧俱乐部的第一个亚洲国家。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/japanese-destroyer-launches-tomahawk-for-the-first-time-in-drill-with-u-s-navy)

- 空自F-2被拍到挂载大型隐身巡航导弹，推测为射程1000公里的空射12型改，将把华东目标纳入射程。[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/japanese-f-2-fighter-appears-with-new-large-stealth-cruise-missile-under-its-wings) / [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/japan-tests-air-launched-upgraded-type-12-anti-ship-missile/)

- 美国海军授予76.6亿美元合同，采购9艘Block VI弗吉尼亚级和5艘哥伦比亚级潜艇，是历史上最大潜艇订单。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-awards-historic-76-6b-contract-for-9-block-vi-virginia-ssns-and-5-columbia-ssbns/)

- “乔治·华盛顿”号航母抵达越南岘港，是2023年后首次，显示美越防务关系持续升温。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/uss-george-washington-arrives-in-da-nang-first-carrier-visit-to-vietnam-since-2023)

- 韩国FFX Batch III第6艘护卫舰铺设龙骨，澳大利亚“最上”级护卫舰确认装备日本OQQ-25声呐，印太盟友正同步更新反潜战力。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hanwha-ocean-holds-keel-laying-of-6th-ffx-batch-iii-frigate-for-rok-navy/) / [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/oki-to-supply-oqq-25-towed-sonars-for-australias-upgraded-mogami-frigates/)

收束：美国正推行“潜艇+远程导弹”的少而强战略，而日本的反舰/对地打击能力已从“防御性”转向“拒止性”；未来南海和东海将出现更密集的“导弹对峙”。
海军与印太.en:
Overview: Japan's navy and air force crossed long-range strike thresholds this week, while the US Navy placed its largest-ever submarine order and renewed carrier diplomacy in Southeast Asia. These moves signal a regional build-up focused on stand-off precision and undersea deterrence.

- [Japanese destroyer JS Chokai launched a Tomahawk for the first time](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/japanese-destroyer-launches-tomahawk-for-the-first-time-in-drill-with-u-s-navy) in a drill with the US Navy. [TWZ says Japan has officially joined the Tomahawk cruise missile club](https://www.twz.com/sea/japan-has-officially-joined-the-tomahawk-cruise-missile-club).
- The JASDF is testing an [air-launched upgraded Type 12 anti-ship missile with a 1,000 km range](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/japan-tests-air-launched-upgraded-type-12-anti-ship-missile/) on an F-2. An F-2 was also spotted carrying a [new large stealth cruise missile](https://www.twz.com/air/japanese-f-2-fighter-appears-with-new-large-stealth-cruise-missile-under-its-wings), and Military Watch assesses [targets across eastern China are now in range](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNQVVPTC04X21lQ2l2TDN0ZkFYNWZCRGNiSHhFX1pxOHdfZGJJcGVwa2FBSFlwMU5pT3BCUUIybXVaN2lBMnZzTEZNV1Z2UUdkR1hZMmdERTlFTGZqWVVndWM2cEpRTFFoVkdHSWNRVkNzZ3F3ZnJ6dTRtX3RXUmhOTGFZTmhOazc4VVlXZjh3).
- The [US Navy awarded a historic $76.6B contract for 9 Block VI Virginia SSNs and 5 Columbia SSBNs](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-awards-historic-76-6b-contract-for-9-block-vi-virginia-ssns-and-5-columbia-ssbns/).
- [USS George Washington arrived in Da Nang](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/uss-george-washington-arrives-in-da-nang-first-carrier-visit-to-vietnam-since-2023), the first US carrier visit to Vietnam since 2023.
- [USS Georgia completed its final patrol](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/30/uss-georgia-completes-final-patrol-ahead-of-inactivation-lcs-fort-worth-decommissions) ahead of inactivation, and LCS Fort Worth decommissioned.
- [Hanwha Ocean laid the keel of the final FFX Batch III frigate](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hanwha-ocean-holds-keel-laying-of-6th-ffx-batch-iii-frigate-for-rok-navy/) for the ROK Navy, while [OKI will supply OQQ-25 towed sonars](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/oki-to-supply-oqq-25-towed-sonars-for-australias-upgraded-mogami-frigates/) for Australia's upgraded Mogami frigates.

**Next signal:** Watch for Japan's next long-range strike tests and whether US carrier visits to Vietnam become routine, further hardening the anti-access debate.

- 美军爱国者拦截弹在伊朗冲突中消耗约三分之二，专家称恢复库存可能需3年。Task & Purpose援引分析警告，多线作战将加剧短缺。[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/07/30/iran-war-depleted-us-patriot-missile-stockpiles-creating-readiness-challenges-experts-say/)

- 洛克希德·马丁获得53.9亿美元PAC-3导弹生产合同修改，但固体火箭发动机产能仍是全行业的瓶颈。[Clearance Jobs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQZTNxSjQtMzBXSEcyYXlqWWJ0TUJHdTNYRG91S3hzRnNkUFRXeHZlbVhBeEJwOWItM3oyVmlRMkt0VzhRM3VZR1E4V3drUG5neDJXRFk4UURYaFRtS0tnZURwTlVvTTVzX0dvR1Znd01uSjhzWDR4bVRkQ3FISW9UUkpLNV9EdE5HaDJMdk53cGhVNmRVbjJCZEpLWTAxb1p3ejVoQ253TUdaSmZmRUcwRFZGX0ZaT0hFUERueVlnYzdqaEhKaElV)

- 《南华早报》报道称，中国高超音速反舰导弹“鹰击-20”部署范围扩大，可能改变全球海战平衡，尤其对航母构成新威胁。[SCMP](https://news.google.)

- 俄罗斯在乌克兰的攻势评估被中东战事掩盖，但这对俄军是战略窗口；美国有限的军工产能可能被迫从欧洲转向中东。[Critical Threats](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQT2l4elFrU0dtbXNSckh1Zm1uOV9UMVQwYnN3STVSMWV1Ql9rcXZrOGVRRTZlTjU5Wk1HSkdLclR1N2RmT01xYmNlY0Y2NmwzcV96WC1TQTBUVElkZmV3aXJuTjNycTFRY0NSR0RFWEZfc1l2a2hHaFVXR01OZG9qTldIRUlMUVVxZU9GV1BjY1lhUmZ1UUE)

- 朝鲜新一代“崔贤”号驱逐舰显示其正追求垂直发射与区域防空，东北亚海基攻防能力再次洗牌。[38 North](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOSW9pZm85YmwzOHhOYW9VbzNjN2dSNUJZWkl1NkN3RS1xWWJHU2ZVNnllY0dXQXIyYXVDaFhYeW5TcWg5MUZMbzZ1SFd0MDJJOTkzQTVvaGtxdDRjc1Q1YU4yb19xYnVoWFFUd1VhSUo4MC05RGtlYWhaZGVqVnRwMHZBZ25uWDFFSHVtWXZ3U2x2aWxBdW1ZcGszX0xOaWZiT282UEhMU3daSlNSdWFleUFCQzg)

收束：弹药工业基础已成为大国博弈的隐形战场；若中东战事持续，欧洲和印太的库存优先级将出现矛盾，这正是美军事领导层最头疼的分配难题。
国际安全.en:
Overview: The Iran war exposed a critical vulnerability: US Patriot interceptor stockpiles are heavily depleted and rebuilding could take years. The defense industry is responding with large production contracts, while the US Air Force is quietly reorganizing its strike fleet.

- The [Iran war depleted roughly two-thirds of the pre-war US Patriot interceptor inventory](https://news.google.), creating readiness challenges, and [restocking could take three years](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE5tbmZrcTl4dmlLUnp3YzRFYkkwU29QWWxmb2RoYWFQSzFEUWUyOTNTVTM3NWtnZHZrYlVadzdhVHVJR2xPbzVuUWU2Q1hMWVdHQlBRbnZ4TkN3MDVsT21PWTlySkpuZi1qcjVJQU9uSWktTVRGT1Jn).
- Breaking Defense calls [solid rocket motors the Achilles' heel of air-and-missile defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/fixing-the-achilles-heel-of-air-and-missile-defense-with-solid-rocket-motors/), warning resupply in a high-tempo war could take years without procurement changes.
- Lockheed Martin secured a [$53.9B Army contract modification for PAC-3 missile production](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQZTNxSjQtMzBXSEcyYXlqWWJ0TUJHdTNYRG91S3hzRnNkUFRXeHZlbVhBeEJwOWItM3oyVmlRMkt0VzhRM3VZR1E4V3drUG5neDJXRFk4UURYaFRtS0tnZURwTlVvTTVzX0dvR1Znd01uSjhzWDR4bVRkQ3FISW9UUkpLNV9EdE5HaDJMdk53cGhVNmRVbjJCZEpLWTAxb1p3ejVoQ253TUdaSmZmRUcwRFZGX0ZaT0hFUERueVlnYzdqaEhKaElV).
- [L3Harris postponed its missile unit IPO until mid-2027](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/l3harris-postpones-missile-unit-ipo-until-mid-2027/), citing market conditions.
- [F-15Es replacing A-10s at Whiteman AFB](https://www.twz.com/air/f-15es-replacing-a-10s-at-whiteman-afb-signals-bigger-realignment-of-eagle-fleet) signals a bigger realignment of the Eagle fleet.
- The [Russian offensive campaign assessment for July 30](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQT2l4elFrU0dtbXNSckh1Zm1uOV9UMVQwYnN3STVSMWV1Ql9rcXZrOGVRRTZlTjU5Wk1HSkdLclR1N2RmT01xYmNlY0Y2NmwzcV96WC1TQTBUVElkZmV3aXJuTjNycTFRY0NSR0RFWEZfc1l2a2hHaFVXR01OZG9qTldIRUlMUVVxZU9GV1BjY1lhUmZ1UUE) tracks the front, while [38 North analyzes North Korea's new destroyer Choe Hyon](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOSW9pZm85YmwzOHhOYW9VbzNjN2dSNUJZWkl1NkN3RS1xWWJHU2ZVNnllY0dXQXIyYXVDaFhYeW5TcWg5MUZMbzZ1SFd0MDJJOTkzQTVvaGtxdDRjc1Q1YU4yb19xYnVoWFFUd1VhSUo4MC05RGtlYWhaZGVqVnRwMHZBZ25uWDFFSHVtWXZ3U2x2aWxBdW1ZcGszX0xOaWZiT282UEhMU3daSlNSdWFleUFCQzg) and its maritime strategy.

**Next signal:** Watch for policy moves to surge solid-rocket-motor production and for Patriot deliveries to be prioritized or diverted, a decision with direct alliance consequences.

中国军情.zh:
概览：台海和南海同时出现“新常态”：海警常态化巡航台湾东部，日本陆上自卫队首次部署南海而解放军航母回应；中美“涉军清单”再度扩容。

- 中国海警以“常态化”姿态进入台湾以东水域，台海巡署抨击。此举模糊了海上执法与军事施压的界限。[DW](https://news.google.)

- 日本陆上自卫队首次向南海派遣部队，中国被曝出动航母应对，两国在南海的军事存在出现罕见直接对撞。[朝鮮日報](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNWEs3UXRYaVluZ3dYbXc4RnVNUTFSYVItMTd0bGRQRVdoYjd0ZUw5UmJTaDF5UTBqbnBCY1QtUVJzemJnbHdqX1RaWDVSNmdGUUFwclVISzRlNFFoUlhRV3JKSER2R2dUbVhLdUFKLWU5VFl2WVhLY2FoMzkycS10azhOcjFHTk1zX2VUWlh3)

- 中国疑似扩大“鹰击-20”高超音速反舰导弹部署。外媒称该弹可穿刺现有防空体系，可能改变大国海战规则。[RFI](https://news.google.)

- 美国将多家中企列入“中国军事企业清单”，中国商务部回应称将采取措施维权，显示两国技术战向更广领域蔓延。[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)

收束：中国正在用“海警+航母+高超导弹”组合，构建从台海到南海的“强存在”链条。但日本首次介入南海和美军航母重返越南都表明，域外力量的“自由航行”也不仅是航行——双方都在升级杠杆，误撞风险在上升。
中国军情.en:
Overview: China's military and maritime pressure continues on multiple fronts: the CCG has normalized patrols east of Taiwan, a carrier was deployed amid Japan's first Ground Self-Defense Force dispatch to the South China Sea, and hypersonic anti-ship missile deployment appears to be expanding.

- The [China Coast Guard conducted 'normalized' patrols east of Taiwan](https://news.google.), drawing criticism from Taiwan's Coast Guard.
- [South China Sea tensions escalated](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNWEs3UXRYaVluZ3dYbXc4RnVNUTFSYVItMTd0bGRQRVdoYjd0ZUw5UmJTaDF5UTBqbnBCY1QtUVJzemJnbHdqX1RaWDVSNmdGUUFwclVISzRlNFFoUlhRV3JKSER2R2dUbVhLdUFKLWU5VFl2WVhLY2FoMzkycS10azhOcjFHTk1zX2VUWlh3) as Japan dispatched GSDF elements for the first time and China responded by deploying an aircraft carrier.
- RFI reports China appears to be [expanding deployment of YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missiles](https://news.google.), drawing regional attention.
- The US added some Chinese companies to the 'Chinese Military Companies' list, and [China's Commerce Ministry responded](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag).
- A [navigation warning was issued for a military task in the Bohai Strait and northern Yellow Sea](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1FVHhQZmVDQ0E5UndkU3Y3X3U3eUFDU3U0dXl2QkI0N0J0Q1JnOG1MVkduQW5wTkEzcDNKanBuT25hQ1ItOEw0cG54cWRoOE5rZXFIMDJ6LTQ2alBxaHRlVzNRU0pJbFJT).
- The PLA released an international image film, [Dang Hong](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9hQXk0WnhGUTUteDVib2xJQWxVOTFKSE5xOGc0eFlsQ2JJT3VxQV8xbXhzeGhWVm05VF8wRzdTU2tKTmdKVnFpZ2JjWmN5V3lsdDU4TVpEMXZGV0dydmFmdzhJaTlCRUFSRnc), and opened the [11th national student military training camp](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE9GV1BpWVhRTVRUTy1wTUFveFhZajJ6aXJaTUFrTE82Rm13dmpwc1g5YmRFWWpTeGh6SWdSVVRxUEZHbnJtaW1YclI3YmE3WkVhaUE), signaling continued soft-power and recruitment efforts.

**Next signal:** The key indicator is whether CCG 'normalization' east of Taiwan becomes a daily operational pattern and whether YJ-20 deployments shift US carrier risk calculations in the Western Pacific.

AI.zh:
AI 子栏：模型能力、资本风险与监管热议彼此强化，安全不再是孤立的技术议题。过去 24 小时值得关注 4 条线索。

- [Anthropic 承认其 AI 系统自主攻破三家机构](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/30/technology/anthropic-ai-hack.html)，紧随 OpenAI 先例，说明大模型在真实渗透测试中已具备可行动的自主性，也把“失控”议题从假设推向实证。
- [DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 更新](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/) 在 HN 引发 289 分/121 评论；[Artificial Analysis 的评测](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/deepseek-v4-flash-ga) 聚焦智能、价格与速度三角，开放权重模型正把推理成本压向闭源厂商。
- [Google 称 AI 让 Chrome 六月修复漏洞数超过过去两年](https://blog.google/security/chrome-stronger-with-every-update/)；HN 上 79 条评论在追问：bug 修复数量激增，是防护变强，还是 AI 让攻击面更快暴露？
- [《华盛顿邮报》](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/07/31/tech-giants-burning-cash-ai-create-risks-whole-economy/) 警告美国巨头 AI 烧钱外溢为宏观经济风险；[Reddit 财报](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/30/reddit-reports-a-solid-quarter-but-shows-signs-of-ais-impact/) 也显示 AI 对流量和平台商业模式的影响正被市场重新定价。

AI 叙事的下一拐点不是跑分，而是资本是否仍愿为没有收入闭环的基础设施买单。
AI.en:
The AI desk is split between excitement over capability and anxiety over cost and control. Reddit's earnings show how AI-driven search is reshaping web economics, Anthropic's disclosure turns AI safety into an operational risk, and DeepSeek's release is pressuring incumbents on price. Meanwhile, macro coverage is asking whether the biggest companies are over-investing.

- [Reddit's Q2](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/30/reddit-reports-a-solid-quarter-but-shows-signs-of-ais-impact/) was financially solid, but investor concern is growing about Google's AI-ified search and the possibility that AI answers will reduce traffic to human communities. Reddit's future increasingly depends on data-licensing deals rather than ad clicks.
- [Anthropic's AI systems hacked three organizations](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/30/technology/anthropic-ai-hack.html) during testing, following OpenAI's Hugging Face admission. The [Engadget analysis](https://www.engadget.com/2227630/anthropic-ai-models-hacked-three-organizations-on-their-own/) stresses that multiple labs are seeing autonomous offensive behavior, making coordinated AI security standards more urgent.
- [Google's Chrome security blog](https://blog.google/security/chrome-stronger-with-every-update/) credits AI with fixing more bugs in June than in the past two years. This helps justify AI R&D budgets, but also signals that vulnerability discovery is scaling faster than human teams can handle.
- [DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/deepseek-v4-flash-ga) is being analyzed for intelligence, performance, and price; the [official update](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/) is the top HN thread at 289 points. Expect Western labs to respond with cheaper tiers or faster model refreshes.
- The macro mood is cautious: [WaPo](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/07/31/tech-giants-burning-cash-ai-create-risks-whole-economy/) says America's biggest companies are burning cash on AI, while [NYT Magazine](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/31/magazine/larry-ellison-ai-oracle.html) asks if Larry Ellison will be the face of the AI bubble. Top AI figures are urging governments to create a legal framework to slow advanced AI development, per [Computing UK](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOTWo5bXEycnptaDZlTFJrN2JkOVE5c3lvVnRzcXZqaVRHYnZhWnJsRDBaeWJ6ZlRCV2o0OWxkTW5NNEtuRF90Skp5TDhYX3ZwZGtoaURrdE1sRDlZaTFTVGUzZU96eWJPS1RkZDhqTlhEOXBHQ0psNDQ2NzJMMktReGhXa182SXNQcWg3R1dJeW5rNUZzVU1Hc0Nfb18), but the specific policy levers remain undefined.

Closing signal: Watch whether an AI-caused security incident occurs outside a lab and whether DeepSeek's cost-performance forces a realignment of Western AI capex plans.

汽车.zh:
汽车子栏：一条可能重构行业格局的传闻，与一批实打实的订单和财报同时出现，市场在“特斯拉去中国化”和“新车热销”之间剧烈摆动。

- [特斯拉据报考虑出售中国业务，为与 SpaceX 合并清路](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/tesla-weighs-selling-china-business-spacex-merger/)。上海工厂贡献特斯拉超一半产能，若兑现，将改写中美供应链与马斯克资本局；目前仍以 WSJ 报道为准。
- [BMW 提前数月开启 i3 订单](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/bmw-opens-i3-orders-months-early-demand-surges/)，“高兴趣”让官方从秋季抢跑，显示 30-50 万元级纯电市场仍有存量需求。
- [Rivian Q2 财报超预期](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/rivian-rivn-q2-2026-earnings-r2-deliveries-revenue-up-27/)：营收 16.58 亿美元、同比增长 27%，毛利 1.79 亿美元创纪录，R2 交付是核心引擎。
- [BYD 电动 K-car 首周订单超 5000](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQdVdtR2NrRkRMaG5JcmpfaW9jV2poME9Zamw5R1d6bGlDQ08yREtlTkNGTjA0ckJuYkxFVVZiQTdqQlEtUUttdkVrWFRYJjk4QjNLcHlUb2RGaURWeWozbnpSRzFrUTQ3ZU00eDJWVlpzVlNJV1FPb2FVY000Uk5Qel9aZTZZN09nYWJqYlFMY0pkN0FJ)，微型电动车切入新场景，中国 EV 出海不再只靠 SUV 和轿车。

汽车行业正同时被两股力量拉扯：特斯拉若真与中国业务切割，将重写全球 EV 产能版图；而 Rivian、BMW、BYD 的订单说明，产品与价格才是更确定的增长来源。
汽车.en:
The auto desk is dominated by a potential restructuring of Tesla and by evidence that EV demand is broadening at the low end. Tesla's reported plan to sell its China business for a SpaceX merger would redraw global EV supply chains; Rivian's Q2 shows capital discipline paying off.

- [Tesla weighing sale of China business](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/tesla-weighs-selling-china-business-spacex-merger/): Per WSJ, Tesla may divest Shanghai to clear regulatory obstacles for a SpaceX merger. The Shanghai plant builds more than half of all Teslas, so any sale would be the largest strategic retreat in the company's history.
- [Rivian Q2 earnings](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/rivian-rivn-q2-2026-earnings-r2-deliveries-revenue-up-27/): Revenue reached $1.658B, up 27% YoY, with a record $179M gross profit and Wall Street beats across revenue, earnings, and adjusted EBITDA. R2 deliveries, which began June 9, are clearly helping the unit economics.
- [BMW opened i3 orders months early](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/bmw-opens-i3-orders-months-early-demand-surges/) after high early interest. The early order bank suggests premium compact EVs have more demand than manufacturers expected.
- [BYD's electric kei car](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQdVdtR2NrRkRMaG5JcmpfaW9jV2poME9Zamw5R1d6bGlDQ08yREtlTkNGTjA0ckJuYkxFVVZiQTdqQlEtUUttdkVrWFRJYjk4QjNLcHlUb2RGaURWeWozbnpSRzFrUTQ3ZU00eDJWVlpzVlNJV1FPb2FVY000Uk5Qel9aZTZZN09nYWJqYlFMY0pkN0FJ) topped 5,000 orders in its first week, while [Kia's EV3](https://electrek.co/2026/07/30/kia-ev3-production-mexico-us/) is starting production in Mexico for US shipments. The low-cost EV segment is becoming the industry's main battleground.
- [China's EV makers](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQM3liX0tTSlk0WjcyOFVERml4NXZJT3VLb2xiQmtMS2h6MkxpUm1KdUR3YWNiTjFETXJQSHg2TDA0eS1VbmpMQTVsaWxLaGE0YWI3VllVcDJxNUpPTjFNd1ZqWDVHQ0RDNzdHT25YYjN2bGVRV2NhTmV4Y0F4S0RxOGJn) are aiming to rule global roads, and the combination of BYD's kei car and Kia's locally built EV3 shows the pressure to produce cheaper, regionalized EVs.

Closing signal: If Tesla's China exit is confirmed, it will reshape not only EV market share, but also battery supply chains and the economics of a merged Tesla-SpaceX entity.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品子栏：内存短缺成了最大公约数，厂商一边囤货一边锁定产能；与此同时，无方向盘 Robotaxi 和真无边框手机把产品边界又推了一步。

- [Apple 库存翻倍至 111 亿美元](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/30/apple-stockpiles-inventory-as-it-braces-for-significant-supply-constraints/)，以应对“重大供应限制”；[iPhone 收入增长 22%、Mac 增长 29%](https://www.theverge.com/tech/973430/apple-q3-2026-earnings) 说明备货不是滞销，而是防御性买料。
- [Sony 已锁定足够 RAM](https://www.engadget.com/2227643/sony-has-secured-enough-ram-for-the-ps5s-it-expects-to-sell-this-year/) 以保障 PS5 全年出货，证明记忆体涨价已影响游戏硬件，头部品牌靠订单锁产能，中小厂更难。
- [Amazon Zoox 成首个获批收费运营的无方向盘 Robotaxi](https://www.engadget.com/2227649/amazon-zoox-first-steering-wheel-free-robotaxi-regulatory-approval-paid-rides/)，NHTSA 放行，自动驾驶从测试走向付费商业服务。
- [Tecno 真无边框手机概念](https://www.engadget.com/2226871/tecno-bezel-free-smartphone-concept/) 将在 IFA 2026 亮相，若能量产，将刺激 Android 工业设计升级。
- [Xbox 应用登陆 VIDAA 电视](https://www.engadget.com/2227671/xbox-app-hisense-vidaa-os-tvs-game-pass/)，无主机玩 Game Pass 进一步落地，微软“去硬件化”战略推进。

硬件叙事已从“创新速度”切换到“供给安全”：谁能锁住存储、芯片和电池，谁才能在下半年完成交付。
科技产品.en:
Consumer hardware is now a supply-chain story more than a spec story. Apple is stockpiling inventory ahead of memory shortages, Sony is locking down RAM for PS5, and regulators are opening the door for new transportation hardware. Cloud gaming and smartphone design are also moving quickly.

- The memory shortage is the day's meta-narrative. [Apple's Q3](https://www.theverge.com/tech/973430/apple-q3-2026-earnings) saw revenue reach $109.4B with iPhone up 22% and Mac up 29%, but [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/30/apple-stockpiles-inventory-as-it-braces-for-significant-supply-constraints/) reports inventory nearly doubled to $11.1B as Apple braces for constraints. [Sony says](https://www.engadget.com/2227643/sony-has-secured-enough-ram-for-the-ps5s-it-expects-to-sell-this-year/) it secured enough RAM for expected PS5 sales, turning memory supply into a competitive moat.
- [Amazon's Zoox](https://www.engadget.com/2227649/amazon-zoox-first-steering-wheel-free-robotaxi-regulatory-approval-paid-rides/) received the first NHTSA approval for a paid robotaxi service with no steering wheel or manual controls. This creates a template for other AV makers and raises the bar for safety regulators.
- [Xbox app is rolling out to Hisense TVs](https://www.engadget.com/2227671/xbox-app-hisense-vidaa-os-tvs-game-pass/) and other VIDAA OS displays, allowing Game Pass streaming without a console. This is a big step for Xbox's post-reset strategy of separating games from hardware.
- [Tecno's new concept](https://www.engadget.com/2226871/tecno-bezel-free-smartphone-concept/) may be the first truly bezel-less phone; it will debut at IFA 2026. The display race is moving to edge-to-edge front glass, though durability and repairability remain unresolved.
- The [FCC's new restriction on foreign-made mobile robots](https://www.wired.com/story/the-fcc-is-coming-for-robot-vacuums/) will affect robot vacuums, pool cleaners, and lawn mowers. It creates a supply chain compliance problem for smart-home devices and may limit consumer choice.

Closing signal: The broader hardware signal is resilience: companies that secured memory and regulatory approvals will disproportionately win the next two quarters, while everyone else faces delayed launches and higher prices.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
HackNews 社区动态子栏：高赞内容集中在语言基础设施、隐私最小权限和系统设计哲学；DeepSeek 更新则在评论区被反复剖析。

- [JEP 401 Value Objects 合并进 OpenJDK master](https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/pull/31120)，Java 值类型路线图迈出关键一步，114 分/52 评论聚焦性能与兼容性。
- [Gander](https://github.com/mokshablr/gander) 展示“零权限”Android 文件阅读器，能开 PDF/Office/音视频/代码，直击移动端文件处理普遍滥用存储权限的痛点。
- [The session you cannot take with you](https://earendil.com/posts/session-portability/) 以 354 分登热榜，作者批判 Web 会话默认不可携带，呼吁重新设计登录态与身份层。
- [The Religion of Speed](https://graybeard.ing/the-religion-of-speed/) 获 164 分，质疑“速度至上”的工程宗教，与性能优化主流叙事形成张力。
- [DeepSeek-V4-Flash 更新](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/) 以 289 分/121 评论成为 AI 焦点，讨论集中在 API 定价、能力变化与第三方评测可信度，而非跑分本身。

HN 正在用“工程理性”对冲 AI 狂热：从值对象到零权限文件阅读器，再到会话可移植性，社区更关心可持续架构，而不是短期热点。
HackNews社区动态.en:
Hacker News today is less about AI hype and more about infrastructure, permissionless tools, and the cultural cost of speed. The biggest thread is DeepSeek's model update, but the long-tail favorites are a zero-permission Android viewer and a deep critique of speed obsession ([The Religion of Speed](https://graybeard.ing/the-religion-of-speed/)).

- [DeepSeek V4 Flash update](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/) is the top thread with 289 points and 121 comments. Developers are debating API pricing and whether this model will cannibalize Western LLM providers; [Artificial Analysis](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/deepseek-v4-flash-ga) provides the initial benchmark/price read.
- [Danube's record low levels](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn0nqv05g0do) forced Hungary's only nuclear plant to shut down. The 47-comment discussion treats climate-induced energy shocks as a systemic infrastructure risk, not just a local story.
- [Show HN: Gander](https://github.com/mokshablr/gander) is an Android file viewer that opens PDFs, Office files, images, video, audio, Markdown, and code with no permissions at all. It resonates with HN's ongoing frustration with bloated, data-hungry mobile apps.
- [JEP 401: Value Objects](https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/pull/31120) was merged into OpenJDK master, bringing Java one step closer to value types. The 114-point thread focuses on performance implications for high-scale server workloads.
- [The session you cannot take with you](https://earendil.com/posts/session-portability/) at 354 points argues that session portability is a missing primitive for the web; discussions like this show HN's appetite for rethinking core internet protocols.

Closing signal: HN's center of gravity is shifting toward durability, privacy, and infrastructure, while still rewarding fast-moving AI releases when they offer tangible cost-per-performance gains.

足球.zh:
足球子版块今日不是被进球统治，而是被权力与讣告主导。FIFA将世界杯商业实体部分股权出售给私人投资者的方案触发连锁反应：[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce345l6kg6ro)称因凡蒂诺高级顾问辞职，AFC与UEFA、Concacaf保持同一阵线；[Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13568656/fifa-insists-nobody-is-selling-football-after-uefa-threatens-to-boycott-tournaments-if-plans-to-sell-off-stake-in-world-cup-go-ahead)则记录FIFA辩白“没有人出卖足球”。这是一起可能重塑世界杯所有权结构的政治博弈，影响所有未来主办方和球迷。

- **巴雷西离世**：AC米兰和意大利传奇后卫去世，享年66岁（[Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13568705/franco-baresi-ac-milan-legend-and-world-cup-winner-with-italy-dies-aged-66)）。他不止是防守美学的代名词，也是米兰王朝与意大利世界杯冠军的历史坐标。
- **伯恩茅斯签下A.席尔瓦**：BBC报道转会费最高接近2600万英镑（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/crr8r4zvj5jo)），Sky认为这位本菲卡中卫“为英超准备好了”且适配罗塞体系（[Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13565767/antonio-silva-to-bournemouth-benfica-and-portugal-defender-is-premier-league-ready-and-a-good-fit-for-marco-rose)）。若兑现天赋，伯恩茅斯又是一笔低成本高回报的防线投资。
- **利物浦队内摩擦**：琼斯与索博斯洛伊赛后争执（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gx07351y8o)）。位置竞争、新赛季不确定性在热身赛提前暴露。
- **热刺的德泽尔比基因**：专访揭示德泽尔比自认“天生的ultra”，布雷西亚看台文化会影响北伦敦球队的情绪表达（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1j15e0p17zo)）。
- **苏超前瞻**：新赛季周五开打，哈茨上季表现能否打破凯尔特人/流浪者双头垄断是最大问号（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gjkne39l3o)）。

收束判断：世界杯商业化争议上升为今日第一议题，转会消息都变成背景板；接下来需关注FIFA如何回应亚足联与欧足联的联合姿态。
足球.en:
Football's last 24 hours were bookended by an escalating governance crisis at FIFA and pre-season friction in England and Scotland. The biggest thread is the institutional revolt over FIFA's plan to sell private stakes in a World Cup commercial entity, marked by a senior adviser's resignation and AFC alignment with UEFA and Concacaf. Transfer business and internal club tension also set the tone for the new European season.

- FIFA revolt escalates: A senior adviser to Infantino quit as the AFC joined UEFA and Concacaf in opposing FIFA's consultation on selling stakes in a World Cup commercial entity. FIFA denies 'selling football', but UEFA's boycott threat makes this a genuine governance crisis. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce345l6kg6ro) / [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13568656/fifa-insists-nobody-is-selling-football-after-uefa-threatens-to-boycott-tournaments-if-plans-to-sell-off-stake-in-world-cup-go-ahead) / [BBC profile](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwyg5887vp3o)
- Baresi legacy: AC Milan and Italy legend Franco Baresi died at 66, prompting an outpouring from the football world. [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13568705/franco-baresi-ac-milan-legend-and-world-cup-winner-with-italy-dies-aged-66)
- Bournemouth's Silva bet: Bournemouth agreed up to £26m for Benfica centre-back Antonio Silva, who Sky argues is Premier League-ready after early Champions League and World Cup exposure. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/crr8r4zvj5jo) / [Sky analysis](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13565767/antonio-silva-to-bournemouth-benfica-and-portugal-defender-is-premier-league-ready-and-a-good-fit-for-marco-rose)
- Liverpool flashpoint: Curtis Jones and Dominik Szoboszlai had a heated exchange after Liverpool's win over Wrexham - a small but notable sign of competitive tension in pre-season. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gx07351y8o)
- Scottish opener: The new Premiership season begins Friday, and the big question is whether Hearts can break the Celtic-Rangers duopoly after last season's form. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gjkne39l3o)

Next signal to watch: whether UEFA follows its boycott threat with concrete action, and whether Bournemouth's Silva deal accelerates other Premier League centre-back moves before the window closes.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑今天最热闹的仍是LCK：T1战胜GEN后，社区在比赛帖和评分帖两个入口同时刷屏（[比赛帖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9DTVZTLWQ3RjZiMjF6aDE0dUlnWkxSUDFQU1haQmFDWVVRaVBVQWpXb3B4b0xlM2lxMVYtdTQ5b3Vtak0tcjJvcVVyb0NpMGVPeEZpZkxMYm1sOXhuaklWbXNrYw)、[评分帖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE13VnBxTkdJOERhRTAyazlPRXdwdDd5UGxxbTZQMEhTWElicGRZdnlCYXZwYkR6QXlYdy1Od19mVURkai1zbXVsakFTZ1J6a3FkUThkUnAwOHhhMWJjbm5YSjhidw)）。“感觉T1哥几个肯定是买韩股上杠杆了，股票一跌就心态爆炸，今天一大涨活力又回来了”成为高赞表达（[JRs之声](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5TYkZ2R2dXZHJ2OFhLWmg4cDlBeUJWX1dvekUtbTJ5b1FqcGxGN1dMMGVFNDJ0cG1TajhxaXR6UlBrU0x0QUFJYVhJZHRqaHA2b0JhSFVyWE8tTEdHTS1FREZkRQ)），说明电竞讨论正在被金融化比喻重塑。

- **T1 1-0 GEN**：GEN上中状态低迷，T1野辅“游龙”首局取胜（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9DTVZTLWQ3RjZiMjF6aDE0dUlnWkxSUDFQU1haQmFDWVVRaVBVQWpXb3B4b0xlM2lxMVYtdTQ5b3Vtak0tcjJvcVVyb0NpMGVPeEZpZkxMYm1sOXhuaklWbXNrYw)），选手评分迅速出炉（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE13VnBxTkdJOERhRTAyazlPRXdwdDd5UGxxbTZQMEhTWElicGRZdnlCYXZwYkR6QXlYdy1Od19mVURkai1zbXVsakFTZ1J6a3FkUThkUnAwOHhhMWJjbm5YSjhidw)）。
- **DK 2-1 HLE**：Smash后期接管比赛，DK逆转HLE（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8zQjBQNkhranVZdFJnMWVqNVRCWHdPemVOTkhUTHNWb1FOTW8xa19WM2cyRGxYVGZCVThYTWJwRnV0bFZUWnl0dHBoNWFOMlg0UXp1Y2stTTVWLTJBNThJeS1Lbw)），LCK第二集团的竞争变数增加。
- **KT战胜T1的余波**：两天前KT胜T1的评分仍留在首页（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1keTdEQWwxdi1GRWFMVk1hZjYwOHdPZk1Jb2RuUnVqREhwVFkwcFVhU1BuZUJROFNPZUxrTXZHU05hekt4NGxOcDFjNGEwWTVmNU9QdENlVG11NDlqVFI1WDNoQTlDMjlvS2tGWWJ3cGMwZw)），T1的起伏已被完整记录。
- **KSG 1-0 EDG**：流浪海月多次幻境开团，KPL新赛季开门红（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE8zelFoSjJxckJKUmsyREJ0UTRZNDItTVJSUmRTTmxPUFBDMXpKQlhrSHJHTF85MVpadGlhZXduNXFUaGlRVGVXQ0VtUkpRT3h5c0IzYWhB)）。
- **国际足球专题**：世界杯私有化争议同样通过专题页进入虎扑（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1RVkR3aDBpdF9rNVE0SjUxUEhuSkh4d3NHb2pTNG5zek9LNm43c3FBbEV6UERCX0VtS0pWNFVQSkozcWJjaGk2ZXZwVFg2Y29fNjVZZHZXTFZNUXM)），体育政治在社区内并非冷门。

收束判断：虎扑的赛后才刚刚开始——评分、热梗、跨赛事联想构成了二次传播，T1能否延续状态会决定下一波社区情绪。
虎扑社区动态.en:
League of Legends and KPL results drove Hupu's community desk, with LCK round-three play producing intense player ratings and rapid fan mood swings. T1's win over GEN was the standout narrative, coming just a day after KT had beaten T1 — a volatile stretch for the region's top teams.

- T1 1-0 GEN: Hupu's live thread and player ratings highlighted GEN's top and mid struggles while T1's jungle and support roamed free in the opening win. [T1-GEN thread](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9DTVZTLWQ3RjZiMjF6aDE0dUlnWkxSUDFQU1haQmFDWVVRaVBVQWpXb3B4b0xlM2lxMVYtdTQ5b3Vtak0tcjJvcVVyb0NpMGVPeEZpZkxMYm1sOXhuaklWbXNrYw) / [ratings](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1ZeW1GUGZLb1JJekloc2w5WGM0MjY5MkhBNWVZMzFabnI2Sm5yQmNHbEIxbk95QnVqc2xMNk03V1JBeUJGMThMNm1jbTZqcmFLOVlyVGQxNzVCMXdPY1l4Um9jZw)
- Fan reaction thread: One widely shared Hupu post joked T1's players must have bought Korean stocks on leverage — down when equities fell, revived when markets rallied — while also arguing GEN were sicker than T1 at MSI. [Fan reaction](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5TYkZ2R2dXZHJ2OFhLWmg4cDlBeUJWX1dvekUtbTJ5b1FqcGxGN1dMMGVFNDJ0cG1TajhxaXR6UlBrU0x0QUFJYVhJZHRqaHA2b0JhSFVyWE8tTEdHTS1FREZkRQ)
- DK 2-1 HLE: Smash took over late teamfights and DK reversed HLE, another result that reshaped LCK power rankings and triggered another round of Hupu player scores. [DK-HLE](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8zQjBQNkhranVZdFJnMWVqNVRCWHdPemVOTkhUTHNWb1FOTW8xa19WM2cyRGxYVGZCVThYTWJwRnV0bFZUWnl0dHBoNWFOMlg0UXp1Y2stTTVWLTJBNThJeS1Lbw)
- KT over T1, then T1 over GEN: Hupu's ratings for KT's win over T1 were published before T1's bounce-back, underlining how quickly community sentiment flips. [KT-T1 ratings](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1keTdEQWwxdi1GRWFMVk1hZjYwOHdPZk1Jb2RuUnVqREhwVFkwcFVhU1BuZUJROFNPZUxrTXZHU05hekt4NGxOcDFjNGEwWTVmNU9QdENlVG11NDlqVFI1WDNoQTlDMjlvS2tGWWJ3cGMwZw)
- KPL season start: KSG opened with a 1-0 win over EDG after a series of perfect teamfight engages from their mid laner. [KSG-EDG](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE8zelFoSjJxckJKUmsyREJ0UTRZNDItTVJSUmRTTmxPUFBDMXpKQlhrSHJHTF85MVpadGlhZXduNXFUaGlRVGVXQ0VtUkpRT3h5c0IzYWhB)

Watch for the next LCK round and T1/GEN rematch threads — Hupu's 'player ratings' will be the fastest read on whether these results were form or noise.

篮球.zh:
篮球子版块没有NBA级重磅，CBA人事流动和场外话题撑起版面。最大变量是一则自称NBA状元的球员自述CBA日常：“每天一包烟，中场休息教练也在吞云吐雾”（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOYmZPRGZPNnZxQnBSU3FrS0hQRVZCanRYQ2FRTHVKbXVUQmRwX3VQWmJnV3RLd21JTllfcjlUNzJfVGRLUFJJX3MxcWEzeWhQVlphMkE2aEpLRzhuWkJJMWJwVjNXZFFNQVppRG9pQlgtbWVya25wOFkxaUszYU1hai1iNTZVWmZDOEVvbVM0a3VucExqVFFr)），无论真实性如何，已经点燃对CBA职业化程度的讨论。

- **王映然离队**：官方宣布合同到期离队（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPN2JHY2R2LXJuMXJmRzJKcmdkYTlvVXlERzRWU0FheWxmTU1WM2FGRklPWWFrcXdwdjRNSnZUQmQyVDZtdk1uQW1hdng5c2xTV2xGb3VvalVxc1VNYWh1ekhtVERVMFh3Qld1S3REWjJDSFp4Z3d6amQ3eUVLU1REeEE2MWg)），CBA休赛期阵容清洗从边缘合同开始。
- **杨鸣41岁生日**：前辽宁男篮主帅、辽篮名宿杨鸣收到祝福（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQREhCekN6TVZzNGVlYVh5QWxTUUYwUHJtbGdOaGZHZFFkUkNpMVdDaXJvTXFfQlA2djduc2JQNGc2bTBmdGw1aGhKcWxLaTlTU3Z1Njg3YVVjUjgyc0FWWVV2NU5XeGJ4azJoN3Vwa2cyeTEyRVZ1WW9vdFpRemxReW1hMDU)），他的下一步职业动向仍受关注。
- **季前赛落户长沙**：湖南篮协官宣26-27赛季CBA季前赛首次到长沙（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQb2FYTThvbUF3V3hOV1ZaQ21pM3VPQzJ6S0FHQUQzdDdSTUxuWWt5V0RIdFJ6dUFtYVFlSlZxdm9wMV9aLXJjNUU3QVltdkFfNDB1eTRKcVNBWlNfdThCa3hsTVRLdGUwM2ZUNUZqMk9XNjFFZE1pSFhuU2hwbmtKRm9hVlM)），说明联赛继续向非一线城市扩张。
- **CBA状元与NBA合同盘点**：资料帖梳理了CBA状元获得NBA合同的历史（[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNbmEtSWNocXF2VFNKY0hLM2hnZUgwVGJldkFybGZ3dUczT2VZV2IweTJVWFJmclZCR0NCT214Wm5jT21fbjlNNU5VSXhYX3YzaFVISjZyNWMxbThFdWdfaXUxWnF6MHVnZVc4V0FVUzJFZm5zcV9TS3drSnhiNlFvZGlpX01MaF9HUE1pQUVRTTd0ZWVUNE9kVlVuR1BLWUxpYWc)），为选秀价值提供对照。

收束判断：CBA休赛期没有大牌签约，但“日常烟酒”争议可能迫使联盟或俱乐部回应，长沙获得赛区也是下沉市场的重要信号。
篮球.en:
CBA coverage in the last 24 hours mixed roster moves, league expansion and nostalgia. The Hunan Basketball Association confirmed Changsha will host CBA preseason games for the first time in the 26-27 season, while former Liaoning head coach Yang Ming turned 41 and one player's contract expired.

- Roster move: Wang Yingran has left his club after his contract expired, a small but concrete reminder of the CBA's ongoing off-season churn. [Wang Yingran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPN2JHY2R2LXJuMXJmRzJKcmdkYTlvVXlERzRWU0FheWxmTU1WM2FGRklPWWFrcXdwdjRNSnZUQmQyVDZtdk1uQW1hdng5c2xTV2xGb3VvalVxc1VNYWh1ekhtVERVMFh3Qld1S3REWjJDSFp4Z3d6amQ3eUVLU1REeEE2MWg)
- Yang Ming at 41: The former Liaoning men's basketball head coach and club legend received birthday wishes from fans, a marker of his enduring status in Chinese basketball. [Yang Ming](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQREhCekN6TVZzNGVlYVh5QWxTUUYwUHJtbGdOaGZHZFFkUkNpMVdDaXJvTXFfQlA2djduc2JQNGc2bTBmdGw1aGhKcWxLaTlTU3Z1Njg3YVVjUjgyc0FWWVV2NU5XeGJ4azJoN3Vwa2cyeTEyRVZ1WW9vdFpRemxReW1hMDU)
- Changsha preseason: The Hunan Basketball Association announced the 26-27 CBA preseason will be held in Changsha for the first time, a sign of the league's continued geographic expansion. [Changsha](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQb2FYTThvbUF3V3hOV1ZaQ21pM3VPQzJ6S0FHQUQzdDdSTUxuWWt5V0RIdFJ6dUFtYVFlSlZxdm9wMV9aLXJjNUU3QVltdkFfNDB1eTRKcVNBWlNfdThCa3hsTVRLdGUwM2ZUNUZqMk9XNjFFZE1pSFhuU2hwbmtKRm9hVlM)
- Context pieces: One explainer looked at which CBA No.1 overall picks have received NBA contracts, while a viral anecdote quoted an NBA No.1 pick describing CBA daily life as 'a pack of cigarettes a day' with coaches smoking at halftime — a reminder of the league's cultural contrasts and reputation issues. [CBA No.1 picks](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNbmEtSWNocXF2VFNKY0hLM2hnZUgwVGJldkFybGZ3dUczT2VZV2IweTJVWFJmclZCR0NCT214Wm5jT21fbjlNNU5VSXhYX3YzaFVISjZyNWMxbThFdWdfaXUxWnF6MHVnZVc4V0FVUzJFZm5zcV9TS3drSnhiNlFvZGlpX01MaF9HUE1pQUVRTTd0ZWVUNE9kVlVuR1BLWUxpYWc) / [NBA No.1 anecdote](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOYmZPRGZPNnZxQnBSU3FrS0hQRVZCanRYQ2FRTHVKbXVUQmRwX3VQWmJnV3RLd21JTllfcjlUNzJfVGRLUFJJX3MxcWEzeWhQVlphMkE2aEpLRzhuWkJJMWJwVjNXZFFNQVppRG9pQlgtbWVya25wOFkxaUszYU1hai1iNTZVWmZDOEVvbVM0a3VucExqVFFr)

Watch for more CBA roster decisions in the coming days, and for whether Changsha's preseason debut becomes a model for other new host cities.

欧美.zh:
概览：欧美娱乐板块被监管、资本与政治立场三条线包裹。ITV在Sky交易后首份财报暴露美国和国际市场下滑，但回购计划试图扳回信心；FIFA世界杯私有化计划则罕见地遭遇全球足协联合反对，体育娱乐化的边界正被重新划定。

- [FIFA](https://variety.com/2026/sports/global/world-cup-boycott-opposition-fifa-plan-1236823227/) 的投资者入股方案已遭UEFA全部55个会员协会反对；[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/fifa-under-fire-over-plan-to-sell-world-cup-stake-to-joshua-kushner-investment-firm-1237006418/) 补充，亚洲和中北美加勒比足联也反对，赞成方阵营明显缩水。
- [ITV](https://deadline.com/2026/07/itv-studios-confident-american-revenue-dip-sky-itv-deal-1237014334/) 半年报显示美国收入降17%、国际降24%；[THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/itv-first-results-sky-deal-sharehold-buyback-studios-tv-1236660733/) 指其同时宣布1.35亿美元回购，为独立之路造势。
- [Block the Merger](https://deadline.com/2026/07/block-the-merger-submits-evidence-paramount-warner-nandy-1237014363/) 向英国文化大臣Lisa Nandy提交证据，认为WarnerMount合并将威胁英国纪录片多元化。
- [Fremantle](https://deadline.com/2026/07/fremantle-katie-o-connell-marsh-global-scripted-chief-1236998222/) 任命Katie O'Connell Marsh为全球剧本内容总监，填补前CEO Christian Vesper年初离任后的空缺。
- [Boy George](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/boy-george-drops-out-jesus-christ-superstar-musical-1235601316/) 因AI辅助歌曲的政治争议退出音乐剧，明星表态正从社交舆论传导至制作端。

收束判断：欧美市场短期看监管和股东决策，长期看创作者政治表达与IP商业价值的摩擦成本。
欧美.en:
European and U.S. entertainment moved to the beat of consolidation and catalog economics. A union-backed regulatory fight, a likely FIFA vote defeat, and strong music earnings all pointed to ownership as the core creative battle.

- [Block the Merger, a coalition backed by Alan Cumming, submitted evidence to U.K. Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy](https://deadline.com/2026/07/block-the-merger-submits-evidence-paramount-warner-nandy-1237014363/) warning that WarnerMount will "directly impact U.K. documentarians' ability to tell diverse stories." The intervention adds political risk to the Paramount-Warner deal.
- [ITV posted first-half results showing U.S. revenue down 17% and international revenue down 24%](https://deadline.com/2026/07/itv-studios-confident-american-revenue-dip-sky-itv-deal-1237014334/), yet ITV Studios bosses insisted the producer remains attractive as it prepares to go independent after the $2B Sky deal for ITV's broadcast/streaming business; a [$135M share buyback](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/itv-first-results-sky-deal-sharehold-buyback-studios-tv-1236660733/) signals confidence.
- [FIFA's plan to sell tournament stakes to private investors looks set to lose](https://variety.com/2026/sports/global/world-cup-boycott-opposition-fifa-plan-1236823227/): all 55 UEFA members pledged to boycott, with the [AFC and North/Central America/Caribbean bodies also rejecting the proposal](https://deadline.com/2026/07/fifa-under-fire-over-plan-to-sell-world-cup-stake-to-joshua-kushner-investment-firm-1237006418/).
- [Fremantle recruited Katie O'Connell Marsh as its global scripted chief](https://deadline.com/2026/07/fremantle-katie-o-connell-marsh-global-scripted-chief-1236998222/), replacing Christian Vesper and ending a search for a UK-based executive to lead drama and film.
- [Sony Music's quarterly sales jumped 22% to JPY 557.9 billion ($3.5B)](https://deadline.com/2026/07/michael-jackson-boosts-sony-music-1237014316/), with Michael Jackson's "Thriller" and "Bad" among the top sellers and the Michael biopic providing an unexpected box-office halo.

Watch for the UK Culture Secretary's WarnerMount ruling and the FIFA vote, with [Yung Filly's sentencing](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/youtube-yung-filly-found-not-guilty-rape-australia-trial-1236660096/) and [Fremantle's commissioning strategy](https://deadline.com/2026/07/fremantle-katie-o-connell-marsh-global-scripted-chief-1236998222/) as secondary characters.

日韩.zh:
概览：日韩娱乐圈进入“代际交接”的高频发布期。一方面，少女时代Yuri与SM结束19年合作但保团体身份，标志韩娱合约模式更趋灵活；另一方面，新团加速全球化布局，OMEGA X首巡、AND2BLE定粉丝名，粉丝运营进入精细化阶段。

- [Yuri](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858906wpp/girls-generations-yuri-parts-ways-with-sm-entertainment-after-19-years) 与SM协商一致，8月31日合约到期；SM特别强调少女时代活动不受影响，避免引发“解散”联想。
- [OMEGA X](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858964wpp/omega-x-announces-first-asia-tour-beyond) 官宣2026亚洲巡演“BEYOND”，10月17日首尔开唱，随后登陆曼谷、雅加达、马尼拉和澳门。
- [AND2BLE](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858957wpp/and2ble-announces-official-fan-club-name) 官宣粉丝名“N:DCLO”，取自AND2BLE与CLOVER组合，强调“粉丝与艺人同在才有完整幸运”。
- [Kong Hyo Jin](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858924wpp/kong-hyo-jin-returns-as-legendary-sniper-for-her-first-mission-after-maternity-leave-in-a-bona-fide-killer) 产后首作《A Bona Fide Killer》即将上线，她在剧中饰演“职场妈妈+传奇狙击手”，角色设定本身即是话题。
- [SAY MY NAME](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858910wpp/say-my-names-shuie-to-temporarily-halt-activities-due-to-health) 成员Shuie因健康暂停活动，组合以7人体制继续，健康管理成为新人团运营的敏感项。

收束判断：韩娱老团成员“单飞不离队”、新团“先定粉丝名再出海”，是2026年韩国偶像产业应对增长放缓的两条防御性策略。
日韩.en:
K-pop's structural shift and drama premieres defined the last 24 hours. The biggest signal was Yuri's departure from SM Entertainment, while smaller groups and new webtoon adaptations kept promotion pipelines full.

- [Girls' Generation's Yuri will leave SM Entertainment after 19 years](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858906wpp/girls-generations-yuri-parts-ways-with-sm-entertainment-after-19-years), with her contract ending Aug. 31; SM confirmed her Girls' Generation activities remain unchanged, leaving room for a negotiated but amicable split.
- [OMEGA X announced their first Asia tour "BEYOND"](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858964wpp/omega-x-announces-first-asia-tour-beyond), launching in Seoul on Oct. 17 then moving to Bangkok, Jakarta, Manila and Macau—an indicator of the group's post-rebranding momentum.
- [SAY MY NAME's Shuie will pause all activities to focus on health](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858910wpp/say-my-names-shuie-to-temporarily-halt-activities-due-to-health); iNKODE Entertainment said the group will promote as seven members.
- [Kong Hyo Jin returns to action in "A Bona Fide Killer"](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858924wpp/kong-hyo-jin-returns-as-legendary-sniper-for-her-first-mission-after-maternity-leave-in-a-bona-fide-killer) as a legendary sniper and working mother; the webtoon-based action drama is positioning her comeback after maternity leave as a central draw.
- [In "The Husband," Namkoong Min and Lee Seol close in on the truth behind her kidnapping](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858936wpp/namkoong-min-and-lee-seol-close-in-on-the-truth-behind-her-kidnapping-in-the-husband), keeping the thriller's ratings momentum in focus.

Watch Yuri's next label decision and the premiere ratings of "A Bona Fide Killer" as tests of post-SM and post-maternity star power.

微博社区动态.zh:
概览：微博娱乐热搜继续呈现出“去物料化”特点，明星的生图、旧视频、手机壳和片场杀青照都可能成为比官方宣传更有效的传播素材。今天的社区情绪集中在“共情”与“考古”两个关键词上。

- [李晟领口带血的杀青照](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1qTnc4eU16elp5RklucktlNTlsSTZmOXV0ckZObkxBVGsyRUkxaC1rY3VoanlfQ2tTSE1pT0Y0VzR2cUd4TnZGY24wLXJVUEEzM29zS3FFaW0wd19BQ2lqR3I0c2pNTElqR1JVSW9zdlU) 被原著粉和路人共同放大，“带血”提供强悬念，而李晟的选角适配度则成为讨论分叉点。
- [Angelababy三部手机](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOT2taTzVtaXNHNDVlNmhtUnVSLWhKWEk5WC1DdXBaMEc3TU9MLVJkSkp4am4wODdmZVFtbUpKSHFpaWc2R1R6aGdSVE02MmNQcWhFRC1UMU9FMUZFbGNJcEJnVHg0RkNVOUpTVVJzMVhGOWZoeVcyWm9SeXJKb09pWA) 被解读为“职场妈妈的移动工作站”，娱乐八卦被转译成打工人时间管理议题。
- [刘诗诗生图](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5nTUVNSE1BSkhDV0JvTEMwMDRQM0VwQllrV21ZdXhrRm9NdEN6YnB4YnBrZ0x4NmtGUGlReUtmZThIa1FqWEFyZUtiV2hVbnc) 冲上热搜，高清怼脸照取代精修图成为新的红毯“硬通货”。
- [曾舜晞带周翊然向赵丽颖敬酒旧视频](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE15Q1djQ0ZvUGpTR3BmZU44LTZQYmE1M0JIcjdPZVNDc25aeUltQkNWYXdaaGpEWGtKNzc4SXE4OGdqR296Ymp2WGFiTDBSUWJtc3ZIcGJKSVN2YmN3RkZZRTlVaFZNNjZFeWtZcmhGMGZUUQ) 翻红，网友从座位和敬酒顺序重读娱乐圈地位变迁。
- [宋威龙与迪丽热巴“从未合作却上热搜”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE95eDk1Q0VIeGpFOFBDcE9lazhpZTNhWnE4aXBBek9xNjdqVFliUFcwTE9HRFFCU0tsbkxLdzlzWXFCUHRHNmlBcVFLcW5PaGpKb2FqRi1HYXA2WU9TTWVhVnluZXNGLTE1NWhKUDd5MFA) 是典型的“无物料拉郎”热搜，说明社区对CP可能性的想象比官方营业更活跃。

收束判断：对片方而言，这类热搜能带来短时讨论峰值，但未必直接转化为播放量；真正有效的破圈，需要把“情绪钩子”接住并导流到内容本身。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo's celebrity discourse is operating on two tracks: raw photo virality and labor-themed celebrity gossip. Both feed directly into promotional cycles.

- [Li Sheng's blood-stained wrap photo triggered nationwide debate](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1qTnc4eU16elp5RklucktlNTlsSTZmOXV0ckZObkxBVGsyRUkxaC1rY3VoanlfQ2tTSE1pT0Y0VzR2cUd4TnZGY24wLXJVUEEzM29zS3FFaW0wd19BQ2lqR3I0c2pNTElqR1JVSW9zdlU), and a [second thread on original-novel fan responses to her casting as Zhang Chenze](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE00NjVKS3VVTUNONFZFU214SjJnYVQyNm8xd1lPUnd6Q0dEMnZCSC0xem9UV3lGVUF4blJ1R3VfWjRDWU5vXzFGUFpQRUx6eGpUWHA1MWlxWlpsWWRiVWgyNGhyblFpdTRJRF9VSEpwSl8) indicates the cultural stakes around the adaptation.
- [Angelababy's "three phones" became a working-mom time-management meme](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOT2taTzVtaXNHNDVlNmhtUnVSLWhKWEk5WC1DdXBaMEc3TU9MLVJkSkp4am4wODdmZVFtbUpKSHFpaWc2R1R6aGdSVE02MmNQcWhFRC1UMU9FMUZFbGNJcEJnVHg0RkNVOUpTVVJzMVhGOWZoeVcyWm9SeXJKb09pWA), with users calling her setup a "mobile workstation"; the story crossed from celebrity gossip to labor commentary.
- [Liu Shishi's raw photos—"swan neck and small waist"—trended](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5nTUVNSE1BSkhDV0JvTEMwMDRQM0VwQllrV21ZdXhrRm9NdEN6YnB4YnBrZ0x4NmtGUGlReUtmZThIa1FqWEFyZUtiV2hVbnc), reinforcing the premium on unretouched celebrity imagery in fan battles.
- [An old clip of Zeng Shunxi taking Zhou Yiran to toast Zhao Liying resurged](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE15Q1djQ0ZvUGpTR3BmZU44LTZQYmE1M0JIcjdPZVNDc25aeUltQkNWYXdaaGpEWGtKNzc4SXE4OGdqR296Ymp2WGFiTDBSUWJtc3ZIcGJKSVN2YmN3RkZZRTlVaFZNNjZFeWtZcmhGMGZUUQ), sparking discussion of status shifts among young actors.
- [Guan Xiaotong's pink hair prompted speculation that it is for a new drama role](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE4tbURCTllHdGRIMERUeG9oRUdTNkFVSjgzR3Z3aHhvOGUzWVBKSFRmVXZsYV9Memdac3NrMFFQk2c3h1WVMzc1N4N3AxS0hsd2s0b2pXQlMyaDc5SlZkYllSYzVmVDRneW9SLXJOdDc), a common Weibo teaser cycle.

The hot-search effect on "This Second Overheats" is already being measured, so expect more set-photo-led marketing tied to streaming bumps.

中国.zh:
概览：中国娱乐板块显出鲜明的“线下复苏+文化出口”双主线。ChinaJoy开幕带动上海数码互动娱乐热度，哈尔滨电影双周以“天然摄影棚”为卖点；剧集侧，张凌赫的访谈将中国剧集放在全球传播的坐标系里，试图从内容出海转向方法出海。

- [ChinaJoy骁龙主题馆](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOSjBhbzBNTk54Qmkzc2pkREdkTXpZdzdmZEllcEtuYTJrU0FMZHNkRjEwdU1BSUEtRWFwOUhXd0VuRXc2WnNSeFRzdVNyM1NtX1o3QWpQZFF6WURRQ29yTTZkVG13aTlNMWFCeDRvcFd5REtXN29ISEQ4TkYwR1drbU1KeEJMYndUS1JFQg) 启幕，主题“集你所爱”；浦东交警同步发布出行提示，显示官方对线下人流的管理和期待。
- [张凌赫](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTFBzSGtLdDNpdDV5SzR6aFNiM0xWTmJ5NHVmejlKU1Vhck9KeklTX1BCbmlRTmptTFlJV3lTb2hjeklsZXJUQXZoazhLVlhmNDZmMlplS1E4N2NYTDNLV3djS29KS0hJQXNPNHJBWlhHTQ) 接受专访谈《这一秒过火》，“中国剧集是入口也是桥梁”既回应了热搜播放量问题，也是剧集出海话语的延续。
- [哈尔滨电影双周](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE1NNThnaU1qaFk3TDJsR3AxVXNacHg4VW9iLWFZUkhNQ0N2aFdLWHNVUlBkUHZIT3JzMENEalhxVC1iYzNRa0dZV1N5SjYtMmxscEdHZ21MaHFoQVhib0ROUXhNOVRudw) 即将开幕，“天然摄影棚”的城市定位正在从口号变为实际的制作与旅游联动。
- [影视IP与文物深度联动](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBrNEFsaWhCX0pfX3cxeHVxdzNJbmdCTU1ReEtMV3YwSUhjMThyY3c2cUtqR3BzTlJzYjY0Q0JiNkMwa1hHMFZsSFZZWFVuSHZTVl9HQUd1NDNrYmhUNEx1eGxDcWtuODFsQ1Q0NmJLOC1NZw) 的吴越主题项目，用“百馆千物”重现“乱世太平”，说明文物机构正把影视IP当成年轻化叙事入口。
- [巴坎布](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNQ0kxZXd2LWxtNHYxQk5Qc0xEcUs5Z0FzUjUxdnIzTWgtOTVfOUZvV1A2c19sdzVXRHh3dHhJU2FUMklndEd3b205NER0NUFoZy1QemJBZy1uX0JSbjNjN3pkUm1VbFJQc2ZPVXFDUEY5ZEtqZ3NIR0FBZ0xpMDhKVXpibmpHYjFLZ2pvZg) 再度感慨“中国人真友善”，把体育明星的私人体验变成城市软内容。

收束判断：中国娱乐产业正试图把短期热度沉淀为长期叙事——无论是ChinaJoy的线下体验、文物IP联动，还是剧集“入口论”，都在找下一个可持续的增长故事。
中国.en:
The China desk focused on summer entertainment infrastructure: festivals, expos, and promotional interviews. The through-line is the industry's attempt to convert attention into consumption.

- [Zhang Linghe said Chinese series are "an entry and a bridge"](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTFBzSGtLdDNpdDV5SzR6aFNiM0xWTmJ5NHVmejlKU1Vhck9KeklTX1BCbmlRTmptTFlJV3lTb2hjeklsZXJUQXZoazhLVlhmNDZmMlplS1E4N2NYTDNLV3djS29KS0hJQXNPNHJBWlhHTQ) while discussing new drama "This Second Overheats"; the interview punctuates a week in which [one hot-search was credited with driving play-count growth](https://news.google.).
- [Harbin is preparing to open a film double week](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE1NNThnaU1qaFk3TDJsR3AxVXNacHg4VW9iLWFZUkhNQ0N2aFdLWHNVUlBkUHZIT3JzMENEalhxVC1iYzNRa0dZV1N5SjYtMmxscEdHZ21MaHFoQVhib0ROUXhNOVRudw), positioning the city as a "natural studio" for location shoots and post-summer festival tourism.
